digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC atomic executors — summary update route
propositions: Exact summary updates must route through a constructor-injected legacy-default selector that bypasses generic retry without advancing baseline when not test-enabled.

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) must map to legacy result surface, advance ADR-0026 baseline with the summary value from the routed mutation's fields, and preserve all existing telemetry.

All non-success dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and further terminal types) must emit exactly one redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points without advancing baseline or persisting deferral.
Mixed-field mutations must remain routed as one unsplit legacy call regardless of selector state.
Terminal outcomes must carry retry_not_before on the manifest for observability only and allow batch work to continue without stopping unrelated operations.
